description: issue #679 (SP7): with `sprites` active, `tell`/`ask`/`each` are profile keywords, so redefining any of them as a PROCEDURE raises `ol-reserved-word` (spec/turtles-and-sprites.md:154,179) -- one diagnostic per `define`, each pointing at the procedure-name token. Paired with reserved-procedures-without-sprites, which semantically CHECKS this exact source under Core alone and is clean: that pairing pins the PROFILE GATE that still applies to these three names. The gate is on borrowed time -- spec/grammar.md:408 makes profile words built-in unconditionally, and retiring it is issue #841 -- but #838 moved only the 45 names it measured, so the pair stays honest about today. Issue #838 did drop the `namespace: "reserved"` param this used to pin (spec/error-model.md:125 gives `params: { name }` only). Both fixtures are `"check": true` (semantic-checker only, no execution) because the rule is a checker rule -- the procedures are never called, and no events are produced. Before this slice the rule was a normative MUST with no fixture at all.

diagnostics.message: tell is already part of OpenLogo. choose another name.
ask is already part of OpenLogo. choose another name.
each is already part of OpenLogo. choose another name.
